alpha-lib.title: Deep dive: alpha-lib
alpha-lib.html:
alpha-lib

Measured at alpha-lib 1def2e9d.

alpha-lib is the estate's refund library. It publishes the @example/alpha-lib npm package, which beta-app depends on, and it holds the refund schema.

What it holds

  • src/refund.ts: the refund function and the RefundHandler class whose

handle method calls it.

  • schemas/refund.schema.json: the Refund JSON Schema, with a money

definition that the total property refers to.

  • package.json: the package name and version 1.2.0.

History

Two commits on main. DEMO-1 added the handler and the package manifest on 1 October 2026; DEMO-2 added the schema the next day. Nothing has changed it since.

Who depends on it

beta-app declares @example/alpha-lib in its package.json and imports refund in src/pay.ts. No other repository in the estate refers to it.

Limits

This dossier describes the code at the commit above and says nothing about how the package is released or who maintains it.
